content: OpenCV 5.0 (opencv-python-headless 5.0.0.93, 2026-07). Python: functions remain cv2.<name>; Python 2 dropped; 1D numpy InputArray maps to 1D Mat; Caffe/Darknet DNN loaders removed; ml, CascadeClassifier, HOGDescriptor need contrib. Latest 4.x is 4.14.0.94. Community migration wiki, not verified against official notes.
